claims: Robert Mueller was FBI director from 2001 to 2013.
Robert Mueller was special counsel for the Russia investigation.
Robert Mueller died at the age of 81.
In September 2025, the House Oversight Committee withdrew a subpoena for Robert Mueller.
The House Oversight Committee is chaired by Rep. James Comer.
The subpoena for Robert Mueller was regarding the investigation into the Justice Department's handling of the Jeffrey Epstein sex trafficking case.
The subpoena for Robert Mueller was withdrawn after it was learned that Mueller had been diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease.
Robert Mueller was diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease in the summer of 2021.
The House Oversight Committee sought testimony from Robert Mueller regarding the 2008 non-prosecution agreement.
The 2008 non-prosecution agreement allowed Jeffrey Epstein to plead guilty to state charges in Florida.
Mueller was head of the FBI at the time of the 2008 non-prosecution agreement.
Mueller’s name appeared in files related to Jeffrey Epstein.

According to a Hindustan Times report on the Epstein files as of March 2026, communications between associates of Epstein mentioned Mueller in the context of his appointment as special counsel for the Trump-Russia probe.
President Donald Trump made hostile remarks regarding Robert Mueller on Truth Social following the announcement of Mueller's death on March 21, 2026.
